tone.target: Ethereal clean-to-edge breakup with delay and roomy ambience

tone.summary: A highly atmospheric signal chain built around a clean US Deluxe or Silver Twin amp model, utilizing Chorus for width, and Digital Delay/Plate Reverb to create the signature ethereal Pink Floyd sound.
corrections: Reduce fuzz to subtle edge grit
Keep modulation present but not dominant
